# Marigold Dental

> Marigold Dental is a comprehensive family and cosmetic dental clinic in Pitt Meadows, BC, offering preventive care, restorative treatments, emergency services, and advanced orthodontics.

Located in Pitt Meadows with services extending to nearby Maple Ridge and Hammond, Marigold Dental is led by Dr. Owais Iqbal and provides a full range of dental services including cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, Invisalign treatment, and emergency care. The clinic accepts the Canadian Dental Care Plan and offers convenient weekend hours.

## Core Services

- [Dental Checkups and Cleanings in Pitt Meadows](https://www.marigolddental.com/services/dental-checkups-and-cleanings): Preventive dental checkups and teeth cleaning with fluoride at Marigold Dental.
- [Emergency Dentist in Pitt Meadows](https://www.marigolddental.com/services/emergency-dentistry): 24-hour emergency dental care for trauma and urgent issues at Marigold.
- [Cosmetic Dentistry in Pitt Meadows](https://www.marigolddental.com/services/cosmetic-dentistry): Cosmetic dentistry services including whitening, veneers, and implants at Marigold.
- [Dental Implants in Pitt Meadows](https://www.marigolddental.com/services/dental-implants): Full-mouth dental implants with titanium and porcelain at Marigold Dental.
- [Root Canal Therapy in Pitt Meadows](https://www.marigolddental.com/services/root-canal-therapy): Root canal therapy and endodontic treatment by specialists at Marigold Dental.
- [Dental Bridges and Crowns Near Me in Pitt Meadows](https://www.marigolddental.com/services/dental-bridges-and-crowns): Dental bridges and crowns in porcelain and ceramic at Marigold Dental.
- [Invisalign in Pitt Meadows](https://www.marigolddental.com/services/invisalign): Invisalign clear aligner teeth straightening orthodontic treatment at Marigold.
- [Oral Cancer Screenings in Pitt Meadows](https://www.marigolddental.com/services/oral-cancer-screenings): Preventive oral cancer screening and detection at Marigold Dental.
- [Dentures in Pitt Meadows, BC](https://www.marigolddental.com/services/dentures): Complete and partial dentures with prosthetic care at Marigold Dental.
- [Dental X-Rays in Pitt Meadows, BC](https://www.marigolddental.com/services/dental-x-rays): Diagnostic dental x-ray imaging services with radiation safety at Marigold.
